We have an exciting opportunity for a Senior Manager, Engineering
at UL Standards & Engagement .

The Senior Manager, Engineering
will support a diverse portfolio of standards and lead a broad scope of interdisciplinary engineering projects and technical initiatives to advance the mission of UL Standards & Engagement (ULSE) to make the world safer, more secure, and sustainable. The Senior Manager, Engineering will serve as a senior technical contributor and subject matter expert across projects providing technical oversight and applying deep engineering knowledge to address emerging and complex safety science challenges. Leveraging expertise in engineering and applied science, the Senior Manager, Engineering will translate scientific insights, research development discoveries and incident trends into actionable strategies that support the advancement of ULSE standards and engagement activities.

As a people leader, the Senior Manager, Engineering will lead, coach and develop a high performing team of technical professionals, including engineers, scientists and safety specialists that will drive technical excellence and continuous improvement to support the development and maintenance of our safety standards.

UL Standards & Engagement

At UL Standards & Engagement (ULSE), we expand the boundaries of safety science to create a more secure and sustainable world. For more than a century, we have created new safety standards and shared our findings with academia, scientists, manufacturers, and policymakers across industries. We identify critical safety and sustainability issues, asking tough questions because we believe a safer world begins with knowledge.

Build a safer, more secure, and sustainable future with us. Join us and work with our Standards teams who develop the standards required to put that knowledge into practice.

What You’ll Learn And Achieve

As the Senior Manager, Engineering
you will play a key role in the rapid growth of UL as you:

Define and drive Engineering strategy aligned with organizational objectives, ensure priorities, resources, and project outcomes support broader standards development and advocacy goals.
Serve as technical lead and subject matter expert for complex projects and strategic initiatives related to product and consumer safety across technical disciplines.
Leverage expertise in engineering and regulatory compliance to enable the development, implementation and continuous improvement of safety standards.
Define and apply engineering methodologies, technical approaches, analytical frameworks and tools used to evaluate safety risks and support evidence based decision making.
Oversee end-to-end projects, plan and execute activities across the project lifecycle and ensure timely and high-quality deliverables.
Forecast project needs and anticipate issues. Develop and apply solutions and implement proactive strategies to address complex, undefined and ambiguous challenges.
Collaborate and partner closely with cross-functional teams to align technical work with organizational priorities and stakeholder needs.
Provide technical oversight within the Engineering function to ensure quality, consistency and rigor of all Engineering initiatives. Integrate Engineering solutions into existing processes and workflows, ensure recommendations are sound and actionable to support successful deployment and adaptation.
Lead, guide, coach and train junior and seasoned team members. Cultivate collaborative environment to ensure team’s success in effective execution of standards activities.
Represent ULSE at industry-related functions such as conferences, seminars and trade shows.
Develop and present technical content for diverse audiences including committees, working groups, conferences and other stakeholder forums. Facilitate technical discussions among stakeholders, to support consensus building and sound decision making.
Maintain continued awareness of industry trends and external context related to the portfolio. Stay current with regulatory requirements and compliance frameworks governing public safety.

Depending on your role, you may be able to discuss flexible working arrangements with your manager. We also provide employees with paid time off, including vacation, holiday, sick, and volunteer days.

What Makes You a Great Fit

While no one candidate will embody every quality, the successful candidate will bring many of the following professional competencies and personal attributes:

Demonstrated expertise and broad technical knowledge in engineering principles related to product safety. Experience in ULSE core segment topics including fire safety, mechanical safety, electrical systems, electrification, sustainability, batteries, energy storage and alternative energy technologies.
Broad knowledge of hazard analysis, risk assessment, testing methodologies, and performance based safety requirements.
Experience defining direction, executing strategy and achieving tangible results. Ability to align project objectives and outputs to broader team and organizational priorities.
Strong project leadership skills, with ability to independently manage complex, multi-phase initiatives involving multiple stakeholders and competing priorities, fostering collaboration and partnership across the organization.
Demonstrated ability to lead and develop high performing teams. Experience setting expectations while establishing and operationalizing clear goals and enforcing accountability for both processes and results.
Excellent communicator and presenter, with ability to distill complex data into clear, compelling narratives and recommendations for a range of audiences.
Strong consultative and partnership orientation, with ability to establish effective relationships and influence others, including senior leaders and external stakeholders.
Sound judgement and analytical rigor, with strong commitment to technical quality. Strategic thinker with the ability to innovate and adapt in a dynamic industry landscape.

Minimum 9 years of directly related technical work experience.
Minimum 2 years people management experience.
Familiarity with product safety, standards development, testing, certification, regulatory compliance, or related technical role.
Experience developing or applying relevant standards, including UL, ISO, and IEC.
Experience with US and Canadian Standards and Codes, as well as national, regional, and international standardization bodies.
PMP or related project management certification a plus.

UL Research Institutes and UL Standards & Engagement are nonprofit organizations dedicated to advancing safety science research through the discovery and application of scientific knowledge. We conduct rigorous independent research and analyze safety data, convene experts worldwide to address risks, share knowledge through safety education and public outreach initiatives, and develop standards to guide safe commercialization of evolving technologies. We foster communities of safety, from grassroots initiatives for neighborhoods to summits of world leaders. Our organization employs collaborative and scientific approaches with partners and stakeholders to drive innovation and progress toward improving safety, security, and sustainability, ultimately enhancing societal well-being.

ABOUT US

Foodsmart is the leading telenutrition and foodcare solution, backed by a robust network of Registered Dietitians. Our platform is designed to foster healthier food choices, drive lasting behavior change, and deliver long-term health outcomes. Through our highly personalized, digital platform, we guide our 2.2 million members—including those in employer-sponsored health plans, regional and national Medicaid managed care organizations, Medicare Advantage plans, and commercial insurers—on a tailored journey to eating well while saving time and money.

Foodsmart seamlessly integrates dietary assessments and nutrition counseling with online food ordering and cost-effective meal planning for the entire family. We partner with national and regional retailers across the U.S., many of whom accept SNAP/EBT, making healthier food more accessible. In 2024, Foodsmart secured a $200 million investment from TPG's Rise Fund to help expand our reach, particularly to low-income workers disproportionately affected by diet-related diseases.

Our core values:

👥  Customer First — You start with the member and work backwards.
🚀  Make It Happen — You act with urgency, use data, and hold high standards.
🤝  One Team — You collaborate with respect and commit as a group.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Data is the lifeblood of Foodsmart. It empowers our executive leadership to steer the business, enables clinical teams to validate member health outcomes, and ensures our health plan partners can hold us to the highest standards. Because our AI-driven insights are only as dependable as the infrastructure supporting them, we require a dedicated architect to lead this foundational work.

We are seeking a Senior Manager of Data Platform to take end-to-end ownership of our data lifecycle: from the moment information lands in our warehouse to its final modeling and delivery to the stakeholders and systems driving our mission forward.

In this role, you will architect the platform’s reliability and performance, managing pipeline orchestration, our dbt project, and the foundational models that keep BI, experimentation, and AI tools synchronized. You will navigate a complex domain involving medical claims, clinical outcomes, and multi-payer eligibility for 2.2 million members, all within a strict HIPAA-compliant environment. To achieve this, you will lead and mentor a senior, distributed data engineering team comprising both domestic and offshore talent.

You will serve as a strategic peer to the Analytics & Data Science team. Together, you will define the architectural vision for our data foundation, ensuring a seamless handoff where they build downstream analytics on the standards you establish. Success in this role requires maintaining a clear, documented boundary between core platform systems and analytics engineering to eliminate ambiguity in ownership.

As a hands-on technical leader, you will focus on scaling the platform through your team’s capabilities rather than individual output. You are a systems thinker who prioritizes fixing the class of problem over the instance, creating durable capabilities that accelerate every downstream team. You will drive excellence through rigorous design reviews and architectural discipline.

Your impact will span the entire organization, partnering with Analytics, Finance, and cross-functional pods dedicated to clinical and member-facing challenges. You will make these collaborations effective by conducting standing roadmap reviews and ensuring platform capacity is allocated transparently and strategically, rather than responding to one-off, isolated requests.

You will

ARCHITECT THE DATA FOUNDATION

Take end-to-end ownership of the data lifecycle, managing everything from pipeline orchestration and our dbt project to the warehouse infrastructure, ensuring peak performance and reliability

Instill a "Data-as-a-Product" philosophy across the organization, treating internal teams as customers by defining rigorous SLAs for data quality, freshness, and accessibility

Establish proactive data observability and contracts, shifting the culture from reactive troubleshooting to a disciplined system that identifies regressions before they impact downstream stakeholders

Translate ambiguous business needs into concrete technical roadmaps, leading discovery with cross-functional partners to turn recurring pain points into scalable architectural solutions

Direct the evolution of our foundational models, applying expert-level dimensional modeling and star schema designs to ensure the platform scales with our AI and analytics footprint

Serve as a strategic partner to Analytics & Data Science, co-architecting the semantic and context layers to establish the standards they build upon

Maintain a documented, transparent boundary between our core product systems and the analytics environment to ensure clarity of ownership

EMPOWER AND SCALE THE TEAM

Mentor and scale a high-performing, distributed data engineering team comprising domestic and offshore talent

Delegate with strategic intent, focusing on expanding platform capacity through the team's technical growth rather than your own individual keyboard output

Drive technical excellence and architectural discipline through rigorous design reviews, RFCs, and code audits

PARTNER STRATEGICALLY ACROSS THE BUSINESS

Act as the technical counterpart to the Analytics & Data Science leadership, ensuring platform investments align with the company's long-term trajectory

Conduct standing roadmap reviews with key stakeholders to prioritize effectively, unblock initiatives, and ensure capacity allocation is transparent

Collaborate with cross-functional pods to ensure data requirements are integrated into the problem definition phase, creating durable rather than isolated solutions

Prioritize fixing classes of problems over instances, building permanent platform capabilities that solve recurring stakeholder challenges

STEWARD CRITICAL DATA OPERATIONS

Direct the data infrastructure supporting revenue cycle management and billing, ensuring the pipelines powering Finance remain flawless

Manage the integrations and models for our member lifecycle systems, guaranteeing that engagement and attribution data remain consistent across the warehouse

Build resilience into vital business reporting through sophisticated automation, comprehensive documentation, and a culture of shared accountability

Lead the platform's HIPAA compliance efforts, architecting the controls for PHI access, deidentification, and audit readiness in partnership with Security

LEAD AI-NATIVE ENGINEERING

Foster an AI-first engineering culture where tools like Claude Code serve as genuine force multipliers for refactoring and documenting infrastructure

Establish the governance standards and safety guardrails required for the responsible application of AI within our engineering workflows

Design the underlying context layer for our AI-powered analytics tools, ensuring generated insights are accurate and dependable by construction

You are

A hands-on technical leader who focuses on scaling through team capability, prioritizing architectural depth over individual keyboard output

A systems thinker who prioritizes fixing the class of problem over the instance, building durable solutions that solve recurring challenges

A strategic partner to cross-functional pods, capable of translating complex business needs into concrete technical roadmaps for stakeholders

A "Bridge-Builder" who moves seamlessly between architecting with senior engineers and explaining the organizational impact of data performance to leadership

Pragmatic regarding technical debt, balancing delivery speed with the architectural discipline required to maintain a performant, stable platform

Expertly opinionated about dimensional modeling and semantic layers, ensuring the platform footprint scales without creating fragmented definitions

Clear-eyed about the steward’s responsibility when architecting controls for PHI and sensitive clinical datasets

You have

Over a decade of expertise in data engineering or platform domains, with at least 4 years dedicated to leading and scaling high-performing teams

Demonstrated hands-on mastery of modern cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift) and sophisticated orchestration frameworks like Dagster or Airflow

Expert-level dbt proficiency, encompassing large-scale project architecture, semantic layer implementation, and seamless integration with BI tools such as Looker or Omni

Advanced command of dimensional modeling at scale, supported by expert SQL abilities and strong Python engineering skills

A deep commitment to Data Reliability Engineering (DRE), with a proven history of architecting CI/CD pipelines and automated quality testing within dbt ecosystems

The ability to influence without authority, successfully driving the adoption of architectural standards and new tooling across cross-functional engineering pods

Experience serving as a strategic technical peer to Analytics and Data Science teams, functioning as an architectural partner rather than a support service

A successful background in managing distributed engineering talent, including domestic and offshore collaborators

Professional fluency in HIPAA regulations and experience architecting infrastructure for sensitive healthcare data, including claims, eligibility, and clinical records

Operational experience with AI-native development tools like Cursor or Claude Code, utilizing them as force multipliers in production workflows

Signals of Success

Cross-functional teams in Product and Finance accelerate their velocity because the underlying data foundation is accurate, stable, and self-service

Ambiguity regarding metric accuracy is eliminated through a unified context layer that synchronizes definitions across BI, experimentation, and AI platforms

Platform priorities and roadmaps are communicated transparently, ensuring every stakeholder understands the strategic rationale behind capacity allocation

Vital business reporting and financial pipelines operate with high resilience, free from single points of failure or reactive troubleshooting

Your engineering team achieves greater technical depth and autonomy under your mentorship and leadership

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

We are seeking a senior, hands-on Distinguished Engineer to lead the delivery of AI-native systems into highly regulated industries such as tax, finance, and risk. This role sits at the intersection of real-world delivery, architecture enforcement, and platform feedback, ensuring that AI systems move from concept to production with speed, safety, and audit-grade rigor.

Unlike traditional architecture or product roles, the Advanced Forward Engineering (AFE) team is accountable for making AI systems work in reality, under client constraints, regulatory scrutiny, and operational pressure.

Client engagements involve cells/pods of Forward Deployed Engineers and the Distinguished AFE operates as a cross‑cell technical leader, partnering closely with Product Engineering, Product Architecture, and governance authorities while remaining anchored in delivery outcomes.

This role is ideal for a seasoned engineer who combines deep technical judgment with strong client presence, systems thinking, and the ability to translate messy field reality into durable, reusable patterns for the enterprise.

Your Key Responsibilities

Serve as a cross-engagement technical authority, ensuring delivery implementations adhere to architecture intent, safety, and economic constraints in regulated environments.
Synthesize learnings from multiple delivery cells into durable reference integrations, validated implementations, and reusable patterns that reduce repeated failure modes.
Work with AI agents to support regulated safe-to-ship decisions by contributing technical evidence and validation inputs.
Operate as a player-coach, contributing directly to complex system design and implementation while guiding delivery teams toward consistent, repeatable approaches.
Own the consolidation, prioritization, and communication of cross-cell product signals, converting field observations and client-specific adaptations into evidence-based recommendations, distinguishing them from isolated customer requests.
Partner with Product Engineering and Product Architecture to package consolidated client patterns into technical business cases, backlog candidates, and platform investment recommendations.
Participate in shaping sessions, architecture reviews, and prioritization discussions, advocating changes that improve portability, operability, and customer outcomes.

Deep technical expertise across a broad range of technology domains (AI/ML, Software Engineering, Systems Design, Security, Compute, Data, Networking, DevOps).
Strong product intuition with the ability to transform field observations into executive-ready recommendations, roadmap inputs, and reusable platform capabilities.
Ability to balance immediate delivery needs with long-term platform evolution, ensuring short-term solutions contribute to enduring enterprise capabilities.
Operate effectively across delivery, architecture, product, and governance domains simultaneously.
High credibility with senior engineers, architects, and client stakeholders.
Pragmatic mindset: balances ideal design with real constraints (regulatory, organizational, environmental).
Clear communicator who can explain complex technical tradeoffs with evidence and precision.
Bias toward repeatability and long-term maintainability over one-off solutions.
Intellectual curiosity and continuous learning orientation in AI-native development and system design.

To qualify you must have

10+ years of experience delivering complex AI enterprise systems, ideally in regulated industries.
Deep experience with distributed systems, cloud platforms, and integration‑heavy architectures.
Hands‑on experience with modern AI‑enabled application stacks (e.g., agentic systems, orchestration frameworks, LLM‑backed services).
Proven ability to operate in forward‑deployed or customer‑facing engineering roles, owning outcomes under real‑world constraints.
Track record of creating reusable technical patterns or platforms that scale beyond a single engagement.
Experience collaborating closely with architecture, product, and platform teams.
Strong understanding of software delivery lifecycle, quality gates, and production readiness in enterprise settings.

Ideally, you'll also have

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or related technical field.
Expertise with AI/ML lifecycle management, observability, and validation approaches.
Experience working with AI governance, security, and cost controls in production environments.
Ability to influence client and internal stakeholders, and platform direction through technical credibility and evidence.
Experience building reference implementations, test harnesses, and validation frameworks.
Exposure to regulated delivery contexts (e.g., financial services, tax, healthcare, risk platforms).

We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job in all geographic locations in the US is $144,000 to $329,100. The base salary range for New York City Metro Area, Washington State and California (excluding Sacramento) is $172,800 to $374,000. Individual salaries within those ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
Join us in our team-led and leader-enabled hybrid model. Our expectation is for most people in external, client serving roles to work together in person 40-60% of the time over the course of an engagement, project or year.
Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

About EYA

EYA is a premier developer and builder of thoughtfully designed, urban, walkable communities in the Washington, DC metro area. For more than 30 years, we have specialized in complex infill residential development—transforming constrained, entitlement-intensive sites into distinctive townhome and mixed-use neighborhoods.
Our projects often involve intricate jurisdictional requirements, structured parking, shared infrastructure, phased delivery, finished pad transfers, and coordination with third-party builders. We operate in some of the region’s most demanding entitlement environments—and we do so successfully because of disciplined planning, technical expertise, and strong execution leadership.

As our portfolio continues to grow in scale and complexity, we are seeking a Head of Engineering and Land Development to lead and evolve our land development platform.

The Opportunity

The Head of Engineering and Land Development is a senior executive responsible for the strategy, structure, and execution of horizontal development across EYA’s portfolio—from early feasibility input during land pursuit through infrastructure delivery, bond release, parcel transfers, and HOA turnover.

While EYA’s real estate acquisitions and development team leads entitlement strategy and jurisdictional approvals, the Head of Engineering and Land Development ensures that engineering oversight, infrastructure planning, budgeting, contractor engagement, and field execution are aligned with the realities of delivering complex urban communities.
This leader evaluates risk, determines delivery structure, safeguards capital, and ensures disciplined execution in environments where precision matters.

Leadership Scope

The Head of Engineering and Land Development leads:
EYA’s internal engineering group (which oversees civil engineering consultants)
The land development preconstruction and estimating function
Land development buyout and contractor procurement
Field land development execution
Bond release and HOA turnover processes

This role reports to the COO and works closely with acquisitions, real estate development, construction, finance, and legal.

Core Responsibilities

Strategic Partnership in Land Pursuit

Partner with acquisitions and development during feasibility and underwriting to assess infrastructure complexity, grading constraints, utility capacity, off-site obligations, and sequencing risk.
Develop and validate horizontal budgets and schedules that accurately reflect urban infill conditions and jurisdictional requirements.
Identify capital exposure and infrastructure risk early in the deal lifecycle.
Advise on land development structuring considerations, including factors that may impact phased delivery and third-party parcel strategies.

Engineering Oversight & Execution Readiness

Provide executive oversight to EYA’s internal engineering team, which manages external civil engineering consultants.
Ensure that site design and infrastructure planning align with cost discipline, constructability, and horizontal sequencing strategy.
Coordinate closely with the acquisition & development team as entitlement plans evolve, advising on execution implications without leading the entitlement process.
Drive transition from approved plans to construction-ready documents with clarity, discipline, and accountability.

Infrastructure Delivery Strategy

Evaluate each project’s complexity, phasing, jurisdictional environment, and risk profile to determine the optimal horizontal delivery approach.
Oversee engagement of qualified site developers who perform all horizontal construction work.
On larger or technically complex communities, determine when to engage a horizontal general contractor early—beginning in preconstruction—with EYA serving in an owner’s representative capacity for infrastructure delivery.
Structure contracts to appropriately allocate risk, protect schedule integrity, and safeguard capital.
Ensure infrastructure execution strategy supports internal vertical construction and, where applicable, finished pad or parcel delivery to third parties.

Preconstruction, Budget Discipline & Buyout

Lead detailed estimating, value engineering, and horizontal budget refinement from underwriting through final buyout.
Oversee contractor procurement and negotiation of major infrastructure agreements.
Build scalable cost benchmarking and forecasting systems to improve underwriting precision.
Maintain disciplined cost control across an increasingly complex portfolio.

Field Execution, Parcel Delivery & Community Turnover

Provide executive oversight of horizontal construction across active communities, including roads, utilities, grading, and off-site improvements.
Ensure timely and coordinated lot or parcel delivery—whether to EYA’s vertical construction team or to third-party builders.
Oversee bond management strategy, inspections, jurisdictional closeout, and bond release.
Lead coordination of infrastructure completion requirements tied to HOA turnover.
Maintain seamless integration between land delivery schedules and vertical production needs.

The Profile

The successful candidate will bring:
15+ years of senior land development leadership experience in residential or mixed-use environments.
Significant experience delivering complex urban infill projects in entitlement-heavy jurisdictions.
Demonstrated ability to manage infrastructure in phased, high-density, and capital-sensitive environments.
Experience structuring horizontal delivery models, including early engagement of general contractors in preconstruction.
Strong financial acumen and comfort partnering in underwriting and capital planning.
Proven leadership of multidisciplinary teams across engineering oversight, preconstruction, and field operations.
Deep familiarity with the DC metro development and municipal landscape preferred.

What Sets This Role Apart

This is not a traditional subdivision land development role.
At EYA, infrastructure must be delivered within constrained urban sites, under intense jurisdictional oversight, often in coordination with third-party stakeholders. Success requires judgment, foresight, disciplined execution, and a strong understanding of both risk and capital.

The Head of Engineering and Land Development will shape how complex communities are physically realized—protecting the company’s investment while enabling high-quality, enduring neighborhoods.

Oversee the architectural direction for both EMRge and the AI OS, ensuring systems are built to scale and adapt.
Lead the evolution and enforcement of engineering standards across the organization: reliability, scalability, security, observability, CI/CD practices, and infrastructure-as-code — so deployments are repeatable, auditable, and low-risk.
Represent Ovative’s technology vision externally: with clients, prospective clients, and industry forums — building credibility that supports business development and client retention.

Partner with Product Management to align engineering capacity to highest-impact roadmap priorities; maintain SOC 2-compliant, enterprise-grade engineering practices.

Own the security and governance framework for the AI OS — ensuring it meets enterprise standards from the start, in partnership with IT and Security
Drive build vs. buy decisions and Ovative’s AI vendor and model portfolio; make pragmatic, business-grounded choices that balance speed, cost, and long-term flexibility.
Establish LLMOps practices across all AI-powered systems: output evaluation, cost attribution, observability, and model lifecycle management

Manage AI infrastructure and LLM inference costs proactively, ensuring costs are delivering impact.
Own engineering hiring strategy and technical bar: define what great looks like at every level and build the talent pipeline that sustains growth.

Executive Leadership

Translate technology strategy for non-technical stakeholders including executive leadership, clients, and business partners — making complex decisions legible and building organizational confidence in the technology direction.
Act as a technology thought partner to the CEO and business leadership — proactively surfacing risks, opportunities, and technology trends that affect Ovative’s competitive position.

18+ years of engineering experience; 7+ years leading engineering managers in high-growth environments — with a track record of delivery, not just direction
Proven track record as a hands-on technical leader — able to engage credibly at the architecture and system design level, not just the organizational level.

Experience operationalizing security requirements in systems with broad organizational reach: access controls, credential management, audit logging, and principles of least privilege.
Strong build vs. buy instincts — vendor evaluation, contract management, and pragmatic integration vs. custom build judgment.
Experience with cloud data infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP); Databricks experience strongly preferred.
Clear communicator across technical and non-technical audiences — engineers, product partners, clients, and executives; comfortable in board-level and client-facing conversations

Experience with Claude Enterprise or the Anthropic API

added.title: Head of Market Structure & Platform Development
added.description:
Position Overview

Apollo Capital Solutions (ACS) is building the foundational infrastructure for the private credit market. Public and private markets are converging and private credit is scaling rapidly, yet the data, settlement and workflow infrastructure underpinning the asset classes remain manual and fragmented. Apollo, through Alternative Asset Trading (AAT), has already facilitated more than $30 billion in secondary private credit volume and is advancing data, index, pricing and settlement workstreams to close that gap. The firms that help define this infrastructure will lead the market.

We are seeking a senior leader, based in Austin, TX, to own the next phase of this buildout: a market structure and platform role covering the institutional trading infrastructure around both traditional and digitally native private assets, spanning liquidity access, execution, custody, collateral, counterparty risk and settlement. Working across business leadership, product, engineering and operations, the individual will commercialize the platform across the private credit ecosystem and assess developments in tokenization and prime-brokerage models. This is a business-building role, reporting to senior ACS leadership.

Primary Responsibilities

Efficient transfer and settlement

Develop transfer and settlement solutions that move private credit from today's manual, consent-driven assignment process toward automated, near-real-time transfer, with authoritative digital records for each asset
Own the end-to-end lifecycle (origination through secondary transfer and servicing) and remove friction at each node: assignment agreements, agent processes and settlement workflows
Extend custody and collateral mechanics to private assets in both traditional and tokenized form, so positions can be held, financed and mobilized with public-market reliability
Advance settlement models, including delivery versus payment, that reduce counterparty and operational risk

Marketplace development

Lead Apollo's market structure strategy across the infrastructure required for private credit to scale: data standardization, index development, secondary trading infrastructure, and digital transfer and settlement
Ensure seamless data integration throughout the asset lifecycle, integrating with ICE Private Credit Intelligence and Apollo's internal systems so deal data stays consistent and operationally useful
Develop the pricing transparency, liquidity access, execution and venue connectivity that let participants transact private assets efficiently, in both traditional and tokenized form
Assess and shape Apollo's approach to tokenization and prime-brokerage models, positioning the platform for the convergence of traditional and digitally native private assets
Interface with market participants and counterparties across the private credit ecosystem, including originators, asset managers, market makers, custodians and prime brokers, to drive adoption of new technologies and platforms
Own the commercial model and P&L across market structure and platform initiatives

Qualifications & Experience

15+ years in private credit, leveraged finance or structured credit, spanning both investment/trading and/or operational/infrastructure roles
Track record of building something from zero to one, whether a new business line, platform or operational capability; this is a buildout role, not a maintenance role
Strong commercial instinct across business models, incentive structures and go-to-market strategies, with comfort owning a P&L and moving from investment phase to revenue
Deep understanding of private credit operational mechanics: assignment agreements, settlement workflows, agent processes and the full lifecycle from origination through secondary transfer and servicing
Experience with institutional electronic trading and its counterparties (market makers, exchanges, custodians and prime brokers) and how they connect for execution, clearing and settlement
Experience with market structure or infrastructure buildouts in adjacent asset classes (syndicated loans, CLOs, ABS); familiarity with LSTA protocols, ClearPar or LXID/CUSIP infrastructure strongly preferred
Familiarity with digital asset market structure (custody, tokenization, on-chain settlement, prime brokerage) and with data-licensing business models; a strong plus as these models mature
Entrepreneurial, collaborative and solutions-oriented, with strong communication skills, high execution discipline and comfort operating with significant ambiguity

About Apollo

Apollo is a high-growth, global alternative asset manager. In our asset management business, we seek to provide our clients excess return at every point along the risk-reward spectrum from investment grade credit to private equity. For more than three decades, our investing expertise across our fully integrated platform has served the financial return needs of our clients and provided businesses with innovative capital solutions for growth. Through Athene, our retirement services business, we specialize in helping clients achieve financial security by providing a suite of retirement savings products and acting as a solutions provider to institutions. Our patient, creative, and knowledgeable approach to investing aligns our clients, businesses we invest in, our employees, and the communities we impact, to expand opportunity and achieve positive outcomes. As of August 2025, Apollo had approximately $908billion of assets under management. To learn more, please visit www.apollo.com.

Our Purpose & Core Values

Our Clients Rely On Our Investment Acumen To Help Secure Their Future. We Must Never Lose Our Focus And Determination To Be The Best Investors And Most Trusted Partners On Their Behalf. We Strive To Be

The leading provider of retirement income solutions to institutions, companies, and individuals.
The leading provider of capital solutions to companies. Our breadth and scale enable us to deliver capital for even the largest projects – and our small firm mindset ensures we will be a thoughtful and dedicated partner to these organizations. We are committed to helping them build stronger businesses.
A leading contributor to addressing some of the biggest issues facing the world today – such as energy transition, accelerating the adoption of new technologies, and social impact – where innovative approaches to investing can make a positive difference.

Outperform expectations

team, we believe that doing great work and having fun go hand in hand, and we are proud of what we can achieve together.

Apollo relies on its people to keep it a leader in alternative investment management, and the firm’s benefit programs are crafted to offer meaningful coverage for both you and your family.
